comment: EU entry point inventory derived from ENTSOG operatorpointdirections metadata: adjacent country maps pipeline origin; LNG Entry point maps terminals. Source: https://transparency.entsog.eu/api/v1/operatorpointdirections (ENTSOG Transparency Platform API/user manual). RU/BY/UA classify Russian pipeline routes; NO Norwegian; DZ/LY/TN North African; LNG type identifies LNG terminals. TN includes the Algeria to Italy pipeline via Tunisia. Metadata inventory refreshed 2026-11-22.
